title: Clinical Context Brief
description: The final artifact a clinician reviews. Decision SUPPORT only. No diagnoses. Every clinical claim must be traceable to a source id.

alert_summary.description: One-line plain restatement of what fired and how far out of range.

contextual_findings.description: The assembled story, each finding tied to a source.

possible_contributing_factors.description: Hypotheses framed as 'factors to consider' ONLY. Never diagnoses. Each must be traceable and carry uncertainty.

factor.description: Phrased as a factor to consider, e.g. 'possible contribution from medication lapse'.

uncertainty.description: What would confirm/refute this; remaining unknowns.

data_conflicts.description: Explicit contradictions between sources. Do not silently resolve.

missing_data_and_uncertainty.description: Required even if short. Relevant data that is absent, stale, or uncollected.

suggested_clinician_considerations.description: Questions/checks for the clinician. NOT orders, NOT treatment decisions.

adjusted_from_triage.description: True if synthesis changed the triage level (keep the higher of disagreements).

safety_disclaimer.description: Required, non-empty. Restates decision-support-only, not a diagnosis, fictional data, requires clinician judgment.

traceability_index.description: Maps every cited source id to its origin. Lets a reviewer/eval resolve each citation.

notes_for_reviewer.description: Optional free text for the human-in-the-loop.
